title: Text: WAS Bob Schaefer ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: I’m watching from 1,000 miles away, so maybe there is something going on behind the scenes, but weak move firing the pitching coach. The problem is Martinez. Just can’t admit it was a colossal mistake
